messages:
Alex: Flagging an oddness: we had a burst of DLQ replays targeting metering-ingest earlier. About 0.6% of events lost route_tag header after replay and invoice previews are showing mismatches for a handful of tenants. Looks like header propagation is getting dropped during replay path. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

Maria: Oof. Can you paste a minimal before/after so we can see what headers are present?

Alex: Yep, sanitized example: 

```
# original message headers: { tenant: t123, route_tag: heavy-embed }
payload: { tokens: 340, model: 'redwood/gpt-x' }
```

```
# after DLQ replay (into ingest topic)
# headers: { tenant: t123 }
payload: { tokens: 340, model: 'redwood/gpt-x' }
```

Sam: That tracks. DLQ republish flow uses kafka-go's republish helper which historically didn't forward headers unless we opt in. We flipped that off when we upgraded clients last year due to null-header crashes.

Jana: Confirmed. The DLQ adapter calls Republish(ctx, msg.Value) and ignores msg.Headers. There's a param to forward headers but disabled for compatibility.

Liam: Missing route_tag -> falls back to default route -> different plan mapping -> invoice preview deltas. This is billing-impacting, we can't accept DLQ changing attribution semantics.

ingest-bot: Incident created: MET-DLQ-ROUTE-1768888888 (https://tickets.internal/INC-3321)

Maria: Suggested remediation: 1) make DLQ republish copy headers when present (with null safety). 2) Add unit test for older clients with null headers. 3) Canary deploy to staging-ingest for 30m and compare invoice preview diffs. 4) Add UI indicator that flags replay-origin events.

Sam: +1. Metric idea: dlq_replay_missing_route_tag{env} and alert if >0.1% for 15m. Also dlq_replay_header_forwarded_count and _dropped_count.

Jana: I'll implement the consumer patch. Small change: copy msg.Headers into republish call and preserve legacy fallback behavior. Question: should we inject a synthetic header x-replayed=true so downstream can easily query?

Liam: Yes, include x-replayed-from-dlq=true. Console can show a "Replayed" flag in invoice preview and it helps for audit and backfill selection.

Alex: Jana open a PR and ping me, I'll help with tests. Maria, can you add the console telemetry card and the alert?

Maria: On it. I'll add a Billing -> Ingest Telemetry card and wire alerts to the pager with Sam's thresholds. Also stub a CSV export for Finance with the affected rows.

Sam: Note: there are old on-prem consumers (resellers) still on v0.9 that won't forward headers until they upgrade. We should add a helm var and a runtime flag so they can opt in post-upgrade.

Jana: Good call. I'll add feature flag 'dlq.copy_headers' default true for new images and a helm toggle for on-prem. Also defensive checks around nil headers in the library.

Liam: Backfill plan: identify replays in last 48h with missing route_tag and try to match original audit entry. Re-ingest only those with a safe match. Run as manual job with dry-run first. Do not auto-fix invoices; Finance prefers manual adjustments.

Alex: I'll sketch the backfill script tomorrow. We need to decide on the console export format. Finance wants tenant, event_ts, tokens, old_route(if any), new_route, estimated_invoice_delta, and a checksum.

Finance-Bot: Finance acknowledged: require deterministic export and sign-off before manual adjustments.

Maria: I'll add the export slice and UX for marking rows as "submitted to finance". Also add a small "Replayed" badge next to invoice-preview rows in the console.

Sam: I'll add the telemetry counters and an dashboards panel. Also create an alert that opens INC if the missing_route_tag rate spikes.

Jana: Opening PR: https://git.internal/prs/12456. Changes: consumer patch, unit test for null headers, runtime flag, and note in migration doc. Tagging @Alex for review.

Alex: Reviewing. Merge checklist: unit tests, staging e2e canary runs, helm var documented, migration note in eng-platform/docs.

ingest-bot: Canary deploy started (staging-ingest) manifest: sha: fedcba987

Maria: Canary numbers after 12m: dlq_replay_missing_route_tag dropped to 0.02%. dlq_replay_header_forwarded_count increasing. Screenshots linked in the ticket.

Liam: Once staging stable, do a progressive rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with checks at each step (invoice-preview diffs, dlq metrics).

Alex: Scheduling production rollout window. Will coordinate with SRE and Finance.

Sam: Reminder: update the runbook with how to inspect DLQ replay traces, the new metrics, and the console 'Replayed' flag.

Jana: PR merged. Monitoring prod canary now.

Maria: Production canary looks green. Preparing CSV export for finance run.

Finance-Bot: Finance confirmed receipt; manual adjustments will be queued next business day after review.

Alex: Closing out: rollout completed, metrics stable, backfill plan executed with dry-run. Finance received deterministic export and will process manual credits. Thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
